verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a commerce fraud-prevention platform, so telling malicious bots apart from legitimate AI buying agents is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions bot detection, AI agents, or agentic-commerce handling. Device profiling, account protection and fraud decisions are related features but do not show this specific capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the product distinguishes malicious bots from legitimate AI buying agents, so agent-driven purchases aren't blanket-blocked as fraud
